records.title: SUIT: Spatial-Spectral Union-Intersection Interaction Network for Hyperspectral Object Tracking
records.abstractSummary: SUIT models band-wise long-range template/search interactions with Transformers, aggregates shared and band-specific cues via set-theoretic inclusion–exclusion, and uses spectral loss for material distribution alignment.

records.title: Spatial–Spectral–Temporal Correlation Filter for Hyperspectral Object Tracking
records.abstractSummary: SSTCF uses spatial–spectral histograms of gradients and fractional abundances, a low-rank constraint for global spectral semantics, and a temporal constraint for filter consistency.

records.title: Spectral–Spatial Synergy Guided Attention Network for Hyperspectral Image Classification
records.abstractSummary: SSSGAN combines stacked residual spectral extraction, hierarchical dual feature enhancement and feature-aware guided attention; the public abstract reports PU, HU2013, SV and LK experiments.

records.title: UBSTrack: Unified Band Selection and Multimodel Ensemble for Hyperspectral Object Tracking
records.abstractSummary: UBSTrack selects three informative bands from arbitrary-band HSI videos to form pseudocolor input, then chooses among model proposals with a local/global appearance ensemble.
